offering_description.value: Makes and sells specialty coatings, sealants, roofing systems and building materials. Customers are consumers, contractors, industrial manufacturers and building owners, reached through its own brands and retail, distributor and direct channels.

primary_products.value: protective and industrial coatings; roof coatings and roofing membranes; sealants and caulks; construction adhesives; consumer paints and home improvement products

primary_services.value: roofing restoration and installation; flooring and waterproofing installation; building envelope maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: roofing contractors, building owners, industrial manufacturers, infrastructure operators; B2C: do-it-yourself homeowners and hobbyists buying through retail stores and online

end_markets.value: construction; industrial manufacturing; infrastructure; automotive refinishing; consumer home improvement

revenue_model.value: product sales: coatings, sealants and consumer products sold to retailers, distributors and contractors; service fees: roof restoration and flooring installation services; project or contract: roofing and waterproofing projects for building owners
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes coatings and sealants from purchased raw materials, sold to contractors and retailers; brand owner: owns consumer home improvement and industrial brands sold through retailers and distributors; service provider: installs and restores roofing and flooring systems for building owners
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; brand owner; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia, Latin America and other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: consumer products, construction products and industrial coatings run as separate businesses with different customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales to large industrial and roofing customers; distributors / dealers: building material distributors and contractor supply dealers; third-party retail: home improvement and hardware retailers; online: e-commerce sites for consumer products
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: chemical, environmental and VOC rules from EPA and OSHA, product safety rules for consumer goods
